'''Grrandash''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Force Adept]] who worked as a pit-boss in the [[Prosperity Casino and Entertainment Center|''Prosperity'' Casino and Entertainment Center]], aboard the [[Cularin Trade Alliance]] ship, the ''[[TAV Prosperity]]''. His main job their was to ensure that people did not use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to cheat in the casino and he took this very seriously. It was his first legitimate job, but he took it up after being betrayed by a former employer. He was present in the casino during the [[Cularin Trade Show]].
